brand.name: RealEstate
brand.tagline: Land you can trust, on the map.

hero.title: Buy the exact plot you can see from the sky
hero.subtitle: Browse verified land on a live satellite map, select the plots you want, and buy with escrow protection — from Accra to Tamale.

howItWorks.title: From search to title deed in three steps
howItWorks.searchBody: Find land by region, budget and size — or pick exact plots straight off the satellite map.
howItWorks.verifyBody: Every verified listing has its indenture, site plan and surveyor's report checked before it earns the badge.
howItWorks.buyBody: Pay with MoMo or card into escrow. Funds release only when your documents and title are handed over.

trust.title: Built to end land fraud, not just list land
trust.verifiedTitlesBody: Indentures, site plans and surveyor reports reviewed before a listing is badged.
trust.escrowBody: Your money is held until documents transfer and title handover are confirmed.
trust.monitoringBody: Watch your plot for encroachment alerts and status changes after you buy.
trust.ratesBody: Transparent per-plot pricing benchmarked across each region.
trust.scamBody: Report suspicious listings; our moderation team investigates every flag.

footer.blurb: The trust-first marketplace for land and property in Ghana. Discover, verify and buy — right on the map.
footer.sandbox: Demo prototype — all data and payments are simulated.
